headline: 5167 Lake Crest went ACTIVE yesterday and immediately drew a 5:30 PM tour — with two MORE showings today (11:15a, 12p) and a third Wednesday, all stacked behind a full-price offer you owe an answer on this morning. That's leverage, not noise. Meanwhile 9 showings still owe you a read, four of them on Altamont.

hotSignals.signal: OFFER IN HAND, TERMS NOW VERIFIED — buyer agent Manda L.'s signed packet reads full $899K list price, $10K earnest, 8/19 close, no closing-cost ask, no home warranty, 5-day inspection, 2.5% buyer-agent comp, no home-sale contingency, preapproved financing. Her buyers start new jobs in four weeks and called this "our one and only." She also asked last night whether she should change the offer.
hotSignals.action: You told her by text you'd answer "in the am." Call Sulman M. by voice first. The listing went ACTIVE yesterday and a second party toured at 5:30 PM, with two more showings today and one Wednesday — competition is real, which argues for taking it clean and squeezing the terms (raise earnest, shorten inspection, pull the close in) over calling highest-and-best.

hotSignals.signal: OFFER RECEIVED — offer via buyer's agent Davis H. (ARC Realty) with a $5K buyer credit and a $3,500 concession. Seth B. asked what the $3,500 covers and the corrected net sheet never went out.
hotSignals.action: Send the corrected net sheet. Note: the day-count on his question isn't verified either way — the 7/20 texts with him were birthday banter, no business receipt. Already tasked, no new alert sent.
